description: This file defines an enumeration 'SessionKey' with static methods for normalizing, creating, and validating session key strings used in session management.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes the main session key by trimming whitespace and defaulting to 'main' if empty.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Creates a session key for an agent by combining agent ID and base key after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given session key string is a canonical main session key, considering specific string patterns.
